integrity: Complete arguments and standard-library numerical checker are supplied. Finite numerical tests corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite harmonic and limiting-measure statements. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The strict extremal identity fixes the third vertex to normalized surface area on S^2; atomic antipodal pairs need an explicit correction. The spectral count theorem is for fixed S^2 and uniform independent vertices. The previously published conditional acute probability and finite-sample variance are credited, not claimed as new. Historical priority provisional; no independent mathematical review.
title: Strict negative type and a one-sided chaos law for acute chord triangles on the sphere
